**Returns:**

The status the HTTP adapters respond with.

## Remarks

`CANCELLED` maps to 499 ("client closed request"): the caller stopped waiting, so this is neither a client nor a server error. `TRANSPORT_FAILED` is client-only and never sent by a service; a server that somehow holds one reports a generic internal failure, so it maps to 500. Clients choose the error class from the envelope's `code`<!-- -->, never from this status.
